description: Write up to 500 overrides from a JSON file, as one atomic insert: a rejected row leaves nothing behind. The file holds an array of { kind: 'set' | 'revoke', targetKind: 'transfer' | 'accrual_lot', targetId, categoryId? }; a set names a categoryId and a revoke doesn't. The last row per target wins.

file.description: Path to a JSON file holding an array of overrides

workspace.description: Workspace alias to run this command in (see `splits auth workspaces`). Overrides SPLITS_WORKSPACE and the active workspace.

name: accounting_categorize_bulk
